In the years when the harvest was bad the poor survive,at worst they were left with a bit of hunger at the end of the day, and if people really starved the feudal lord would buy bread from other parts of Europe and people would resist until the next harvest.

In the fourteenth century the bad harvests became more frequent. Every year the chroniclers of the time record an increase in the prices of bread, the malnourished people got sick more easily, the children would grow weak and stunted. From 1315 to 1317 in most of Europe the harvests were really bad and people would starve. This stratagem works, but slowly over the decades you get to a point where it is no longer possible to expand.
